    Finding the right code

    We gave the same model three pharmacy code questions, twice per method. Both methods returned the correct file, function, and behavior on all six attempts.

    Benchmark method and limits

    Each attempt started a fresh Claude Haiku 5.5 conversation at repository revision 68ef0f4. Graph began with one semantic lookup. Source search began with a regular expression. Both could then search, list files, and read source with the same result cap. Each had eight model turns. The metric sums API input and output across requests, including repeated context. It excludes local Graph indexing and does not measure project-wide savings. These three lookup tasks were chosen by the team.

    Why the simulator uses the same call driver

    We retrieved a saved team decision: the phone call and the simulator must use the same driver, rules, and decision record. A separate testing path could let the simulation pass while callers still hit a bug.

    The scenario runner starts an isolated session, reads the finished call record, and saves its result before emitting the score. The repository Brain reported 33 active team-authored memories.
